sources.title: Caravela Boa Esperança, Câmara Municipal de Lagos photograph and description

decisions.basis: Provision casks and planked storage crates occupy a framed lower hold with main hatch access. This is an adapted, authored spatial decision; cited analogues establish the feature class rather than these coordinates.

This is an adapted, authored spatial decision; cited analogues establish the feature class rather than these coordinates.
A real open seat frame and removable pot are placed in a measured clear cabin footprint. This is an authored period-furniture adaptation; an inaccessible decorative beakhead seat is not claimed.

A 3m hollow timber boat with adult-scale thwarts, oars and real skids is an optional authored fitting, accepted only where measured final gun/rig geometry leaves a supported bay clear of access. Its compact dimensions and location are authored against measured clear geometry, not copied from a stock mesh or claimed as Batavia dimensions.

The retained game-family hand-worked capstan is placed at -0.07 L between the mainmast and aft companionway. This authored clearance decision keeps its full bar sweep outside the preserved mast and real access openings. The museum source supplies period construction and accommodation context; it does not measure or establish this capstan station.

The two retained forward lower-gunport sills are housed in shallow exact seats cut in their same-side waterways. This authored assembly correction removes the measured 16 mm solid intersections while retaining the sill, full floor and hull silhouette. The carved waterways retain metric grain UVs and their real seat geometry through every LOD. The museum analogy supports wooden ship construction, not these precise joint dimensions or the fantasy caravel gun scale.

The finished authored 32-gun arrangement includes the full three-metre hollow timber boat, adult-scale thwarts, oars and physically supported skids in a measured clear main-deck bay. Its location and compact dimensions are authored; the Batavia rescue-boat account does not establish this vessel, boat size or exact stowage. Optional lower-battery tool lockers are omitted because no real footprint clears the final guns, ropes, frames and aisle; the actual wheeled battery equipment supplies that working room.
